title: Tommy Ladnier and Joe Alba known only in Chicago
summary: Miller says he first saw Ladnier and a second musician in Chicago and comments on their records.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: He's above the staff. Yeah, he is above the staff. Did you know Tommy Lightnere down here?
No, I heard of him when I got in Chicago. To tell the truth, I saw him. But he left and went to England or somewhere while I was there.
And I never knew no more of him. Did you know Joe Alba down here? Down here?
No. First time I saw him was in Chicago.
Have you ever heard any of his records? Yeah. Well do you think his records sound like him or what?
Sound like him? Yeah. He's clearly sure to sing on.
